ST0086 WP-04 Part B, first in decision 100's one judge run, in vc's order:
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (4ae2585f7479): AC-04.6's CLI share.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-wait-v2 (2421b3d9719d): AC-04.4, with slots wait, slots watch and the hook's slots pending.
- ic's refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (8126a568631b): the page's half.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-init-v1 (e8aee9ac86d6): AC-04.5.
- refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-ats-v1 (f649be3fa3ea): the AT markers on Part A's tests, a test for AC-04.2's lane re-open and LaneBusy close, and the NamedMismatch text asserted.
- ic's pipeline-cell-width-v4 (e058514c0734): CSS only.
Then cc's 0657 v3 (doing 97), cc's ST0081 WP-02 v1 (doing 98) and ic's 0658 v3.
ONE RUN, hv's ruling as vc decision 100, which replaces decision 96(1)'s train after this one, so 0657 lands with Part B. vc's landing commit is pre-written as a tenth patch, refs/bank/vc/train/landing-patch (blob f7ca69de3772), which cc rebuilt and read at 09:57Z: cc's CHANGELOG texts verbatim, install's refusal item in cc's words, and both docs prettier-clean. MEASURED in a scratch index on main 21d764a94, every bank applying in that order at its recorded patch-id. With 0657 v2, at 09:06Z by cc's clock, the nine gave tree 4944cfe4135a, equal to vc's, and at 09:57Z the landing patch over them gave 198cccf6fd82. With 0657 v3 in v2's place, at 10:31Z, the nine give 7563ffe7e9cb and the landing patch over them gives 4e04059ef867.
THE FIRST RUN WAS RED: request 01M5YCYJ073KP632DV2QY6RTT0, granted by molt-vc on hv's "ok, go", ran 10:04:07Z to 10:09:06Z by vc's clock in tmp/wt-vc-train over the ten patches at tip 7256572e4, and was released at 10:10:46Z. intentsvcs did not compile, on 0657 v2's duplicate `first_line` in install.rs (doing 97), so no Rust leg judged any bank. 0657 v3 is banked, and vc verified it at 10:40Z by vc's clock. RUN 2 STARTED at 10:51Z by vc's clock. The judge applied the ten patches, with v3 in v2's place, over dc6e357f8 to tip tree 7d0437f04ed2, which cc reproduced from the banks at 10:51Z, and its fmt leg is green. Until the landing nothing commits under a path the ten patches touch. After a green run: one landing chain, one build all, one kovacs preflight and one push.
A RED in any bank comes back to its author, read by its mechanism; the bank is fixed or pulled and the run repeats once. cc fixes forward in tmp/wt-cc-0086b (Part B, detached on scratch tip ddc43caba), tmp/wt-cc-0657 or tmp/wt-cc-0081. Each read clean at 10:30Z with its index at its bank's tree, tmp/wt-cc-0657's at v3's (19bdc7816677). A fix-forward bank carries no CHANGELOG hunk, and its line goes to vc as text. A bank that moves is told to vc and ic, and a later bank that no longer applies over it is re-banked by its author.
OWED IN THE ONE LANDING CHAIN, drafted on refs/bank/cc/0086/landing-drafts-v2 (blob 51c459de4231). v2 supersedes v1 (1a031c080c2a, kept) on AT-04.6's page arms alone: v1 named `page`, the file's helper, and the arms are its two tests, the_estate_page_reads_no_key_the_reader_never_sends and the_estate_page_reads_no_lane_key_the_reader_never_sends.
- AT rows for AC-04.1 to AC-04.6 and AC-04.8 to AC-04.13, each citing slots.rs (coordinator.rs for 04.5) with the arms its ST0086 AT-04 markers name. Read at 10:57Z by cc's clock in run 2's judged tree, every arm is one `#[test]` fn and the hook's two bounds are bats `@test`s. The check fired on a planted missing name and on a planted helper, and it cannot see a one-word name, so those were read. The judge's evidence goes in after the verdict, and `intent at lint ST0086` and `intent ac status ST0086` run before the commit.
- design.md through `intent st attach`: three text edits (E1 controller_unreadable after the `controller` sentence, E2 `queue` in the `lanes` sentence, E3 UNREADABLE on the controller bullet), and E4 after the verdict, pending's cost measured with the judge's binary under `--lane none`, as dated figures and never as a bound. ORDER, cc's finding at 10:08Z, which ic agreed and vc took: ic's design-cells-v1 goes first, since its hunk carries line 27 as context and refuses after E1, or it goes on as ic's exact text insertion after "oldest ask first." in either order; then cc's edits; then 0658's four.
cc's CHANGELOG lines and the status-v2 clause are in vc's landing texts and patch.
Worktree removals wait for molt-vc's Spotlight word, under decision 98 as amended. No push, no release.
